top_findings.title: Overlapping Brasileirão datasets double-count every match in seasons 2012–2019 for all tools except standings
top_findings.evidence: data.go:39,43 load both Brasileirao_Matches.csv (seasons 2012–2022) and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (Ano 2003–2019) under competition "Brasileirao"; both hold 380 rows for 2019. The de-dup fix in server.go:266-279 is scoped to standings() only. Live: team_statistics{team:Flamengo,season:2019,competition:Brasileirao} => "76 matches | 56W 12D 8L | points 180 | win rate 73.7%" (spec example TASK.md:241 expects 90 pts, 28W 6D 4L over 38 matches); competition_statistics => "760 matches" (should be 380); search_matches => "76 match(es)" (should be 38). standings itself is correct (Flamengo-RJ 90 pts, 380 matches).
top_findings.suggestion: Move the modern-source preference out of standings() into matchesFor() (or de-duplicate at load time by date+teams), so team_statistics, head_to_head, competition_statistics, biggest_wins and search_matches are not doubled for 2012–2019.
